title: Current qualification truth: semantic suite passes, clean live HID generation pending
summary: dev9 has package-side semantic/FIDO/Raw-Gadget bridge evidence under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 and a working Raw Gadget substrate. The dev8 CAFE:F1D0/no-HID observation is explicitly rejected as provider evidence because that run's presenter failed UDC acquisition with EBUSY and the script inspected a stale generation.
invariants: The dev9 package-side suite passes dependency, core, Chapter 9, profile, configuration-state, HID profile, CTAPHID, CTAP2 GetInfo, credential, Raw Gadget presentation-error and Raw Gadget control-direction tests.
The target Raw Gadget substrate was proven on kernel 7.2.8-1-default with raw_gadget, dummy_hcd, /dev/raw-gadget and dummy_udc.0.
The earlier dev8 USB node CAFE:F1D0 is not accepted as evidence about the dev8 presenter because that presenter later failed Raw Gadget RUN/UDC registration with EBUSY.
dev9 adds an idle-UDC precondition, presenter ready marker, sysfs-path:devnum generation tokens, stronger cleanup and direct trace persistence.
A clean dev9 live PASS still requires presenter-owned new CAFE:F1D0, HID class 03 and matching hidraw.
libfido2 discovery, browser/WebAuthn enrollment and OpenAI/other relying-party acceptance remain later qualification stages.
procedure: Do not reinterpret the invalid dev8 no-HID result as a provider defect.
Run the clean dev9 live qualifier on an idle UDC.
Only after HID/hidraw PASS, add libfido2 and browser/WebAuthn evidence as separate gates.

provenance.claim: Validation records package-side passes, Raw Gadget substrate, invalidated dev8 observation, dev9 generation guard and pending clean live acceptance.
